sections.title: Two more new stems
sections.content: Just like van became volt-, megy ("go") and jön ("come") switch to their own special stems in the past: ment- and jött-. Once again, the personal endings on top are the ordinary ones you already know from this unit — only the stem itself needs memorizing.

items.english: I went to the movies yesterday.

items.spanish: Zsófia és Tamás hozzánk jöttek tegnap este.
items.english: Zsófia and Tamás came to our place yesterday evening.

sections.content: The old megy/jön distinction still applies: ment describes motion away from the speaker, jött describes motion toward the speaker — exactly the rule you already use for the present tense and for bemegy/bejön.
